zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:0.stem:
【无中生有】原文：Tom went to the store yesterday. He looked at various items on the shelves. After some time, he bought a bottle of milk.
题目：What did Tom do at the store?（汤姆在商店里做了什么？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:0.stemHtml:
【无中生有】原文：Tom went to the store yesterday. He looked at various items on the shelves. After some time, he bought a bottle of milk.
题目：What did Tom do at the store?（汤姆在商店里做了什么？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:0.explanationHtml: 原文直接写明 bought a bottle of milk；B 增加「商店拥挤」和「赶快买」的原因，属于无中生有。

options.text: A. He bought a bottle of juice.（他买了一瓶果汁。）
options.html: A. He bought a bottle of juice.（他买了一瓶果汁。）

options.text: B. He thought the store was too crowded and decided to buy milk quickly.（他觉得商店太拥挤，于是决定赶快买牛奶。）
options.html: B. He thought the store was too crowded and decided to buy milk quickly.（他觉得商店太拥挤，于是决定赶快买牛奶。）

options.text: C. He bought a bottle of milk.（他买了一瓶牛奶。）
options.html: C. He bought a bottle of milk.（他买了一瓶牛奶。）

options.text: D. He looked at fruits only.（他只看了水果。）
options.html: D. He looked at fruits only.（他只看了水果。）

zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:0.explanation: 原文直接写明 bought a bottle of milk；B 增加「商店拥挤」和「赶快买」的原因，属于无中生有。

teaching.translation: 汤姆在商店里做了什么？

phrases.meaning: 看了看各种各样的商品

optionAnalysis.why: 原文买的是牛奶（a bottle of milk），不是果汁；果汁是同类事物替换，属无中生有的细节替换。干扰点：利用商店场景里最常见的商品设套。
「觉得商店太拥挤」「决定赶快买」原文都没有交代，属于无中生有地补入原因和心理。干扰点：内容与主题相关、读起来合理，但原文从未提到。
原文直接写明 he bought a bottle of milk，直接信息题照抄原文事实即可。
原文说他看了货架上的 various items（各种各样的商品），「只看了水果」既缩小了范围，也与事实相反。

steps: 审题：题目问 Tom 在商店做了什么，圈关键词 Tom、at the store。
定位：回原文找到 bought a bottle of milk 一句。
比对：C 与原文一致；B 补入了原文没有的原因，A、D 偷换了对象。

sourceContext.label: 课件 · 第二部分 无中生有例句（原文演示）
sourceContext.quote: After some time, he bought a bottle of milk.

zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:1.stem:
【扩大或缩小范围】原文：Some experts believe that the new policy will have a positive impact on small- and medium-sized enterprises.
题目：Which of the following is true according to the passage?（根据文章，以下哪项正确？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:1.stemHtml:
【扩大或缩小范围】原文：Some experts believe that the new policy will have a positive impact on small- and medium-sized enterprises.
题目：Which of the following is true according to the passage?（根据文章，以下哪项正确？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:1.explanationHtml: Some experts、small- and medium-sized enterprises 均与原文范围一致；A 把中小企业扩大为全部企业。

options.text: A. Experts believe that the new policy will have a positive impact on all enterprises.
options.html: A. Experts believe that the new policy will have a positive impact on all enterprises.

options.text: B. Some experts think the new policy benefits small- and medium-sized enterprises.
options.html: B. Some experts think the new policy benefits small- and medium-sized enterprises.

options.text: C. No experts believe the new policy is good for small- and medium-sized enterprises.
options.html: C. No experts believe the new policy is good for small- and medium-sized enterprises.

options.text: D. Some experts doubt the new policy’s impact on small- and medium-sized enterprises.
options.html: D. Some experts doubt the new policy’s impact on small- and medium-sized enterprises.

zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:1.explanation: Some experts、small- and medium-sized enterprises 均与原文范围一致；A 把中小企业扩大为全部企业。

teaching.translation: 根据文章，以下哪项正确？

optionAnalysis.why: 原文限定为 some experts 和 small- and medium-sized enterprises；A 把「一些专家」扩成 experts（全部），把「中小企业」扩成 all enterprises。典型扩大范围。
Some experts 与原文一致，benefits 是 have a positive impact on 的同义替换，范围限定语一个没丢。
「No experts believe…」与原文 some experts believe 的肯定方向相反，把部分肯定整体反转。
「doubt the impact」原文未提；原文是肯定影响，质疑态度属无中生有。

steps: 审题：Which is true，四个选项都要回原文核对。
定位：原文 some experts believe… will have a positive impact on small- and medium-sized enterprises。
比对：B 的限定语与原文逐词一致；A 把 some/all 换掉，C 反转肯否，D 补了原文没有的态度。

sourceContext.label: 课件 · 第二部分 扩大或缩小范围例句（原文演示）
sourceContext.quote: Some experts believe that the new policy will have a positive impact on small- and medium-sized enterprises.

zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:2.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:2.stem:
【反客为主 · 课件第 53 题】原文：Bob’s wife Sandy has a full-time job, and he really prefers her bringing home extra income. Yet he also feels uneasy and troubled. “She puts me off. First she makes dinner, then the kids need something, or a friend calls her. She talks with her sister, her girlfriends, her workmates, but not with me. I sometimes do feel abandoned and annoyed.”
题目：Which of the following statements about Bob and Sandy is true?（以下关于鲍勃和桑迪的陈述，哪项正确？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:2.stemHtml:
【反客为主 · 课件第 53 题】原文：Bob’s wife Sandy has a full-time job, and he really prefers her bringing home extra income. Yet he also feels uneasy and troubled. “She puts me off. First she makes dinner, then the kids need something, or a friend calls her. She talks with her sister, her girlfriends, her workmates, but not with me. I sometimes do feel abandoned and annoyed.”
题目：Which of the following statements about Bob and Sandy is true?（以下关于鲍勃和桑迪的陈述，哪项正确？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:2.explanationHtml: 原文列举了桑迪做饭、照顾孩子、接朋友电话以及与亲友和同事交流等忙碌情形；C、D 擅自补入「没有共同话题」「不再爱他」等主观原因。

options.text: A. Bob doesn’t wish Sandy to do a full-time job.
options.html: A. Bob doesn’t wish Sandy to do a full-time job.

options.text: B. Sandy is too busy to have time talking with Bob.
options.html: B. Sandy is too busy to have time talking with Bob.

options.text: C. Sandy puts Bob off since there’s no common topic between them anymore.
options.html: C. Sandy puts Bob off since there’s no common topic between them anymore.

options.text: D. Sandy feels equal to Bob now and no longer loves him as before.
options.html: D. Sandy feels equal to Bob now and no longer loves him as before.

zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:2.explanation: 原文列举了桑迪做饭、照顾孩子、接朋友电话以及与亲友和同事交流等忙碌情形；C、D 擅自补入「没有共同话题」「不再爱他」等主观原因。

teaching.translation: 关于鲍勃和桑迪，以下哪项陈述正确？

optionAnalysis.why: 原文 Bob really prefers her bringing home extra income（他反而喜欢她挣外快），「不希望妻子全职工作」与原文相反。
原文列举她做饭、照顾孩子、接朋友电话、与姐妹和同事交谈等忙碌情形，确实没时间和 Bob 说话，属于对客观细节的概括。
「两人没有共同话题」是选项替人物编造的原因；原文只说她忙，没说为什么。反客为主。
「她不再爱他」是擅自加入的主观判断，把 Bob 的失落感升级为婚姻结论。反客为主。

steps: 审题：关于 Bob 和 Sandy 哪项正确，逐选项核对。
定位：原文 Sandy 的忙碌清单 + Bob「有时觉得被冷落和恼火」。
比对：B 只是概括客观事实；C、D 补入原文没有的原因和动机，A 与原文方向相反。

sourceContext.label: 课件 · 第二部分 反客为主例句（课件第 53 题原文演示）
sourceContext.quote: She talks with her sister, her girlfriends, her workmates, but not with me. I sometimes do feel abandoned and annoyed.

zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:3.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:3.stem:
【极端错误 · 课件第 15 题】原文：Knowing the psychology of the game isn’t a sure ticket to winning. But it can help. Ken “Whitey” Watson is one of the world’s best rock, paper, scissors players. He says winning takes skill. “You have to size up your opponent.” Luck and chance play a part, but “you have to be prepared and have a strategy,” he says. “Part of my strategy is being confident.”
题目：What is Ken Watson’s view on the game?（肯·沃森对这个游戏有什么看法？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:3.stemHtml:
【极端错误 · 课件第 15 题】原文：Knowing the psychology of the game isn’t a sure ticket to winning. But it can help. Ken “Whitey” Watson is one of the world’s best rock, paper, scissors players. He says winning takes skill. “You have to size up your opponent.” Luck and chance play a part, but “you have to be prepared and have a strategy,” he says. “Part of my strategy is being confident.”
题目：What is Ken Watson’s view on the game?（肯·沃森对这个游戏有什么看法？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:3.explanationHtml: being confident 是策略之一，能够增加获胜机会；A 的 sure、C 的 wholly 把原文的有限作用绝对化，D 把 size up（判断、估量）误解为「体型大小」。

options.text: A. Being relaxed is a sure ticket to winning.
options.html: A. Being relaxed is a sure ticket to winning.

options.text: B. Being confident can increase the chance to win.
options.html: B. Being confident can increase the chance to win.

options.text: C. Your chance of winning wholly depends on luck.
options.html: C. Your chance of winning wholly depends on luck.

options.text: D. Your chance of winning relates to the size of your opponent.
options.html: D. Your chance of winning relates to the size of your opponent.

zsb-english:19:quiz-e1:3.explanation: being confident 是策略之一，能够增加获胜机会；A 的 sure、C 的 wholly 把原文的有限作用绝对化，D 把 size up（判断、估量）误解为「体型大小」。

teaching.translation: 肯·沃森对这个游戏有什么看法？

phrases.meaning: 估量、判断你的对手（不是「对手的体型」）

optionAnalysis.why: 原文说了解心理 isn't a sure ticket to winning（不是获胜保证）；A 把「不是保证」偷换成「放松即必胜」，sure 的限定被保留下来却安在原文否认的内容上。
原文 Part of my strategy is being confident. 自信是策略的一部分，能够增加获胜机会，与 B 一致且没有夸大。
原文说 Luck and chance play a part（运气起一部分作用），wholly depends on luck 把部分作用绝对化为全部。极端错误。
把动词短语 size up（估量、判断）拆成名词 the size of your opponent（对手的体型），词形词性改变伴随词义改变。以假乱真。

steps: 审题：问 Ken Watson 对游戏的看法，圈人名回原文。
定位：winning takes skill… Part of my strategy is being confident. 并注意首句 isn't a sure ticket to winning 的否定。
比对：B 与 confident 对应；A 的 sure、C 的 wholly 都是绝对化，D 是 size up 的拆词陷阱。

sourceContext.label: 课件 · 第二部分 极端错误例句（课件第 15 题原文演示）
sourceContext.quote: “You have to size up your opponent.” Luck and chance play a part, but “you have to be prepared and have a strategy,” he says. “Part of my strategy is being confident.”

zsb-english:19:quiz-d1:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-d1:0.stem:
原文：The first study found that among more than 350 Americans, increased reading of literary fiction when growing up was connected with greater “psychological richness.” … In the second study, the researchers said that among around 2,200 university students, those who read literary fiction were less likely to simply accept authority.
题目：According to the passage, university students who read literary fiction would ______.（根据文章，阅读文学小说的大学生会怎样？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-d1:0.stemHtml:
原文：The first study found that among more than 350 Americans, increased reading of literary fiction when growing up was connected with greater “psychological richness.” … In the second study, the researchers said that among around 2,200 university students, those who read literary fiction were less likely to simply accept authority.
题目：According to the passage, university students who read literary fiction would ______.（根据文章，阅读文学小说的大学生会怎样？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-d1:0.explanationHtml: 原文 were less likely to simply accept authority 与 A 同义；C 的 certainly 把「可能性较低」极端化。

options.text: A. not easily accept authority（不会轻易接受权威）
options.html: A. not easily accept authority（不会轻易接受权威）

options.text: B. probably accept authority（可能接受权威）
options.html: B. probably accept authority（可能接受权威）

options.text: C. certainly not accept authority（肯定不接受权威）
options.html: C. certainly not accept authority（肯定不接受权威）

options.text: D. simply accept authority（轻易接受权威）
options.html: D. simply accept authority（轻易接受权威）

zsb-english:19:quiz-d1:0.explanation: 原文 were less likely to simply accept authority 与 A 同义；C 的 certainly 把「可能性较低」极端化。

teaching.translation: 根据文章，阅读文学小说的大学生会怎样？

phrases.text: be less likely to do sth.

optionAnalysis.why: 原文 were less likely to simply accept authority（不太可能轻易接受权威）与 not easily accept authority 是同义替换，副词短语换形容词，语义等价。
probably accept authority 与原文方向相反：原文说他们「不太可能」接受。
certainly not accept 把「可能性较低」极端化为「肯定不接受」，certainly 是原文没有的程度限定。
simply accept authority 掉了否定词 less likely，方向反了——这恰是原文说他们「不会」做的事。

steps: 审题：问读文学小说的大学生怎样，圈 university students、literary fiction。
定位：第二项研究 those who read literary fiction were less likely to simply accept authority。
比对：A 是同义替换；B、D 肯否反转，C 用 certainly 加重程度，都不忠于原文。

sourceContext.label: 课件 · 第三部分 题型一 细节理解（间接信息）例句
sourceContext.quote: In the second study, the researchers said that among around 2,200 university students, those who read literary fiction were less likely to simply accept authority.

zsb-english:19:quiz-v1:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-v1:0.stem:
原文：The schools are reluctant to take off—even teachers with tickets for the England-Argentina game had trouble getting the day off.
题目：The underlined word “reluctant” in the passage may probably mean _____.（文中画线词 reluctant 最可能是什么意思？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-v1:0.stemHtml:
原文：The schools are reluctant to take off—even teachers with tickets for the England-Argentina game had trouble getting the day off.
题目：The underlined word “reluctant” in the passage may probably mean _____.（文中画线词 reluctant 最可能是什么意思？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-v1:0.explanationHtml: 破折号后的「连持票教师都很难请到假」解释了学校不愿放假。
zsb-english:19:quiz-v1:0.explanation: 破折号后的「连持票教师都很难请到假」解释了学校不愿放假。

teaching.translation: 文中画线词 reluctant 最可能是什么意思？

phrases.meaning: 放假；休假（此处指学校停课）

optionAnalysis.why: kind（友善的）无法解释「连持票教师都很难请到假」，与语境的阻滞感不符。
破折号后的解释「连有英格兰—阿根廷球票的教师都难请到假」说明学校不愿意放假，reluctant＝unwilling。标点给出的解释线索。
free（自由的；空闲的）与「很难批假」的事实方向相反。
careless（粗心的）代入后语义不通：学校不是「粗心地放假」，而是不情愿。

steps: 审题：画线词 reluctant，回原文看所在句。
定位：破折号后的解释 even teachers with tickets… had trouble getting the day off。
比对：「很难请到假」= 不情愿 → unwilling；排除 kind / free / careless。

sourceContext.label: 课件 · 第三部分 题型二 词汇理解（解释线索）例句
sourceContext.quote: The schools are reluctant to take off—even teachers with tickets for the England-Argentina game had trouble getting the day off.

zsb-english:19:quiz-v1:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-v1:1.stem:
原文：Another popular adaptation is mimicry. Mimicry is when an animal has markings or other physical characteristics that allow it to look like some other kind of animal or plant.…
题目：Which of the following could best explain the word “mimicry” in paragraph 3?（以下哪项最能解释第 3 段中的 mimicry？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-v1:1.stemHtml:
原文：Another popular adaptation is mimicry. Mimicry is when an animal has markings or other physical characteristics that allow it to look like some other kind of animal or plant.…
题目：Which of the following could best explain the word “mimicry” in paragraph 3?（以下哪项最能解释第 3 段中的 mimicry？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-v1:1.explanationHtml: 定义句直接说明：动物的身体特征使它看起来像另一种动物或植物。

options.text: A. An animal’s physical characteristics don’t look like some other kind of animal or plant.
options.html: A. An animal’s physical characteristics don’t look like some other kind of animal or plant.

options.text: B. An animal’s physical characteristics look like some other kind of animal or plant.
options.html: B. An animal’s physical characteristics look like some other kind of animal or plant.

options.text: C. An animal’s physical characteristics look like the same kind of animal or plant.
options.html: C. An animal’s physical characteristics look like the same kind of animal or plant.

options.text: D. A plant’s physical characteristics look like some other kind of animal or plant.
options.html: D. A plant’s physical characteristics look like some other kind of animal or plant.

zsb-english:19:quiz-v1:1.explanation: 定义句直接说明：动物的身体特征使它看起来像另一种动物或植物。

teaching.translation: 以下哪项最能解释第 3 段中的 mimicry？

optionAnalysis.why: 多了 don't，把定义整体反转：拟态恰恰是「看起来像」而不是「不像」。干扰点：在正确表述上塞一个否定词。
定义句 Mimicry is when an animal has markings or other physical characteristics that allow it to look like some other kind of animal or plant. 与 B 几乎逐词对应。
the same kind（同一种类）偷换了 some other kind（另一种类），差一个词，语义完全不同。
D 把主语换成 a plant's，原文定义的实施者是 an animal——动植物只是「被像」的对象，不是拟态的发出者。

steps: 审题：解释 mimicry，回第 3 段找定义句。
定位：Mimicry is when an animal has markings… to look like some other kind of animal or plant。
比对：B 与定义句对应；A 加否定反转，C 把 other 换成 same，D 把实施者换成植物。

sourceContext.label: 课件 · 第三部分 题型二 词汇理解（定义句）例句
sourceContext.quote: Mimicry is when an animal has markings or other physical characteristics that allow it to look like some other kind of animal or plant.

zsb-english:19:quiz-tf1:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-tf1:0.stem: Which of the following is NOT true?（以下哪项不正确？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-tf1:0.stemHtml: Which of the following is NOT true?（以下哪项不正确？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-tf1:0.explanationHtml: 如今牙齿不必费力，是因为较硬食物经过烹煮变软；下颌变小解释的是智齿萌出空间不足和疼痛。

options.text: A. Usually wisdom teeth erupt through the gums in the corners of our mouths.（智齿通常在口腔角落穿过牙龈萌出。）
options.html: A. Usually wisdom teeth erupt through the gums in the corners of our mouths.（智齿通常在口腔角落穿过牙龈萌出。）

options.text: B. Our ancestors’ jaws were bigger than ours.（祖先的下颌比我们的更大。）
options.html: B. Our ancestors’ jaws were bigger than ours.（祖先的下颌比我们的更大。）

options.text: C. Our teeth do not need to work hard now because our jaws have become smaller.（如今牙齿不必费力，是因为我们的下颌变小了。）
options.html: C. Our teeth do not need to work hard now because our jaws have become smaller.（如今牙齿不必费力，是因为我们的下颌变小了。）

options.text: D. Our ancestors needed wisdom teeth to chew hard foods.（祖先需要智齿来咀嚼坚硬食物。）
options.html: D. Our ancestors needed wisdom teeth to chew hard foods.（祖先需要智齿来咀嚼坚硬食物。）

zsb-english:19:quiz-tf1:0.explanation: 如今牙齿不必费力，是因为较硬食物经过烹煮变软；下颌变小解释的是智齿萌出空间不足和疼痛。

teaching.translation: 以下哪项不正确？

optionAnalysis.why: A 与原文相符（智齿在口腔角落穿过牙龈萌出），题目要选 NOT true，故不选。
B 与原文相符：祖先吃坚硬未烹煮的食物，下颌比我们的更大，不是题目所求。
原文说如今牙齿不必费力是因为 we cook many of these tougher foods to make them softer（食物煮软了）；「因为下颌变小」解释的是萌出空间不足和疼痛，不是牙齿不必费力的原因。张冠李戴。
D 与原文相符：祖先确实需要智齿咀嚼坚硬食物（helped them grind the foods down）。

steps: 审题：先圈 NOT true，方向是不能选与原文一致的项。
逐项定位：A、B、D 都能在原文找到对应句；C 的两个分句在原文都有，但因果关系被接错。
判定：C 把「食物煮软」的原因安到「下颌变小」上，属 NOT true。

sourceContext.label: 课件 · 第三部分 题型三 是非判断（智齿篇）
sourceContext.quote: Of course, now we cook many of these tougher foods to make them softer, so we don’t need to work so hard with our teeth.

zsb-english:19:quiz-r1:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-r1:0.stem: What can be concluded from the passage?（从文章可以得出什么结论？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-r1:0.stemHtml: What can be concluded from the passage?（从文章可以得出什么结论？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-r1:0.explanationHtml: for every writer kissed by fortune there are thousands more whose longing is never rewarded，表明成功者只是极少数；A 否定努力作用，B 把低报酬说成「回报丰厚」，C 把普通未成功写作者偷换成著名作家。

options.text: A. Writers’ success depends on luck rather than on effort.
options.html: A. Writers’ success depends on luck rather than on effort.

options.text: B. Genuine writers often find their work interesting and rewarding.
options.html: B. Genuine writers often find their work interesting and rewarding.

options.text: C. Famous writers usually live in poverty.
options.html: C. Famous writers usually live in poverty.

options.text: D. The chances for a writer to become successful are small.
options.html: D. The chances for a writer to become successful are small.

zsb-english:19:quiz-r1:0.explanation: for every writer kissed by fortune there are thousands more whose longing is never rewarded，表明成功者只是极少数；A 否定努力作用，B 把低报酬说成「回报丰厚」，C 把普通未成功写作者偷换成著名作家。

teaching.translation: 从文章可以得出什么结论？

optionAnalysis.why: 原文承认 there's a big difference between being a writer and writing，强调要真写作而非追逐名利；说成功「靠运气而非努力」把作者的忠告扭成宿命论，与原文相反。
原文说写作是 a lonely, private and poor-paying affair，「觉得工作有趣且回报丰厚」与「报酬微薄」直接冲突。
「著名作家通常生活贫困」偷换了对象：原文说的是成千上万没有出名的普通写作者，不是著名作家。
for every writer kissed by fortune there are thousands more whose longing is never rewarded 表明成功者只是极少数——由明示信息走半步得出的结论。

steps: 审题：concluded 表明是推理题，找原文的事实基础。
定位：for every writer kissed by fortune there are thousands more whose longing is never rewarded。
比对：D 是最小延伸；A 否定努力、B 美化报酬、C 偷换对象，都走了一步以上。

sourceContext.label: 课件 · 第三部分 题型四 推理判断（作家篇）
sourceContext.quote: The reality is that writing is a lonely, private and poor-paying affair; for every writer kissed by fortune there are thousands more whose longing is never rewarded.

zsb-english:19:quiz-m1:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-m1:0.stem: What is the main idea of the text?（本文的主旨是什么？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-m1:0.stemHtml: What is the main idea of the text?（本文的主旨是什么？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-m1:0.explanationHtml: 首段总述 most animals and plants 为适应环境而发展出生存方式，后文分别说明伪装、拟态和适应新环境；A、B 以偏概全，D 将一种适应方式扩大为全部。

options.text: A. Animals adapt to their habitat in order to survive.
options.html: A. Animals adapt to their habitat in order to survive.

options.text: B. Plants adapt to their habitat in order to survive.
options.html: B. Plants adapt to their habitat in order to survive.

options.text: C. Animals and plants adapt to their habitat in order to survive.
options.html: C. Animals and plants adapt to their habitat in order to survive.

options.text: D. Both animals and plants use camouflage to mix themselves with the environment.
options.html: D. Both animals and plants use camouflage to mix themselves with the environment.

zsb-english:19:quiz-m1:0.explanation: 首段总述 most animals and plants 为适应环境而发展出生存方式，后文分别说明伪装、拟态和适应新环境；A、B 以偏概全，D 将一种适应方式扩大为全部。

teaching.translation: 本文的主旨是什么？

optionAnalysis.why: 只讲 animals，漏掉了同样谈到的 plants，以偏概全。
只讲 plants，与 A 对称地以偏概全。
首段总述 most animals and plants… adapting to severe habitats，后文分别讲 camouflage、mimicry、适应新环境，C 覆盖全文。
把 camouflage 一种适应方式扩大为全部适应方式；且只讲 animals 没讲 plants。双重偏。

steps: 审题：main idea 题，先定体裁——说明文，找主题句。
定位：首段 most animals and plants… have developed ways of adapting to severe habitats。
比对：C 覆盖动植物与各种适应方式；A、B 各偏一半，D 把一种方式当全部。

sourceContext.label: 课件 · 第三部分 题型五 主旨大意（动植物适应篇）
sourceContext.quote: As you can imagine, most animals and plants want to stay alive. They have developed ways of adapting to severe habitats, and hiding or escaping from those who would like to eat them.

zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:0.stem: The Prince always felt regretful about stories because _____.（王子为什么总对故事感到遗憾？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:0.stemHtml: The Prince always felt regretful about stories because _____.（王子为什么总对故事感到遗憾？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:0.explanationHtml: 定位 p3：regretted they had to have an end，遗憾的是故事都有结局。

options.text: A. he had too much wealth（他太富有）
options.html: A. he had too much wealth（他太富有）

options.text: B. there was a terrible famine（发生了严重饥荒）
options.html: B. there was a terrible famine（发生了严重饥荒）

options.text: C. all stories have ends（所有故事都有结局）
options.html: C. all stories have ends（所有故事都有结局）

options.text: D. there was no storyteller（没有讲故事的人）
options.html: D. there was no storyteller（没有讲故事的人）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:0.explanation: 定位 p3：regretted they had to have an end，遗憾的是故事都有结局。

teaching.translation: 王子为什么总对故事感到遗憾？

optionAnalysis.why: 「太富有」原文有提及（half his wealth），但不是他遗憾的原因；把背景信息当原因是张冠李戴。
famine 是年轻人讲的国王故事里的内容，不是王子本人遗憾的原因；把故事内情节移植到故事外人物上。
定位 he always regretted they had to have an end：遗憾的是所有故事都有结局，C 与原文直接对应。
「没有讲故事的人」与原文相反——风险太大，整整一年无人敢来，不等于没有讲故事的人。

steps: 审题：问王子遗憾的原因，圈 regretful about stories。
定位：he always regretted they had to have an end。
比对：C 的 all stories have ends 是 had to have an end 的同义改写；A、B、D 与因果无关或相反。

sourceContext.label: 课件 · 练习一《无尽的故事》第 1 段
sourceContext.quote: But he always regretted they had to have an end.

zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:1.stem: The young man risked telling an endless story to the Prince for _____.（年轻人冒险讲无尽故事是为了什么？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:1.stemHtml: The young man risked telling an endless story to the Prince for _____.（年轻人冒险讲无尽故事是为了什么？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:1.explanationHtml: 定位 p4：The risk is worth your fair daughter；年轻人明确指向王子的女儿。

options.text: A. a great sum of money（一大笔钱）
options.html: A. a great sum of money（一大笔钱）

options.text: B. the Prince’s beautiful daughter（王子美丽的女儿）
options.html: B. the Prince’s beautiful daughter（王子美丽的女儿）

options.text: C. showing his bravery（展示勇气）
options.html: C. showing his bravery（展示勇气）

options.text: D. both A and C（A、C 两项）
options.html: D. both A and C（A、C 两项）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:1.explanation: 定位 p4：The risk is worth your fair daughter；年轻人明确指向王子的女儿。

teaching.translation: 年轻人冒险讲无尽的故事是为了什么？

phrases.text: tell a story without an end
phrases.meaning: 讲一个永无结局的故事

optionAnalysis.why: 奖赏的一半财富原文确实提到，但年轻人自己点明的动机是「为了您美丽的女儿」，不是一大笔钱。
定位 The risk is worth your fair daughter：年轻人直接说明冒险是为了王子的女儿。
「展示勇气」原文未提；poetically（措辞得体）不等于炫耀勇敢，属无中生有。
A 和 C 都不对，D 自然不成立；干扰点是用 both A and C 制造「全覆盖」的假象。

steps: 审题：问年轻人冒险的目的，圈 risked telling an endless story。
定位：The risk is worth your fair daughter。
比对：B 是年轻人自己说出的动机；A、C 均为外加或无关。

sourceContext.label: 课件 · 练习一《无尽的故事》第 1 段
sourceContext.quote: “The risk is worth your fair daughter,” the young man replied poetically.

zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:2.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:2.stem: The young man would be sent to prison if he failed to tell a story without an end _____.（若失败，年轻人会被关多久？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:2.stemHtml: The young man would be sent to prison if he failed to tell a story without an end _____.（若失败，年轻人会被关多久？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:2.explanationHtml: 定位 p5：sent to prison for life，即终身监禁，等同 forever。

options.text: B. for some time（一段时间）
options.html: B. for some time（一段时间）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:2.explanation: 定位 p5：sent to prison for life，即终身监禁，等同 forever。

teaching.translation: 如果讲不出没有结局的故事，年轻人会被关多久？

phrases.text: be sent to prison for life

phrases.meaning: 终身（= forever 的同义替换）

optionAnalysis.why: 原文 Anybody who failed would be sent to prison for life；for life＝forever，同义替换成立。
for some time（一段时间）把终身刑大幅缩短，与 for life 不符。
for a while（一会儿）同样缩小了刑期范围。
for a year 来自原文的 a whole year（一年无人敢来讲故事），把「无人来」的时间偷换成「坐牢」的时间。干扰点：两个时间都在原文出现过。

steps: 审题：问失败会被关多久，圈 sent to prison。
定位：Anybody who failed would be sent to prison for life。
比对：for life 与 forever 同义，选 A；D 的 a year 是原文另一处的时间，注意区分。

sourceContext.label: 课件 · 练习一《无尽的故事》第 1 段
sourceContext.quote: Anybody who failed would be sent to prison for life.

zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:3.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:3.stem: In order to prevent famine, the King asked his men to build _____.（为防饥荒，国王命人建造什么？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:3.stemHtml: In order to prevent famine, the King asked his men to build _____.（为防饥荒，国王命人建造什么？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:3.explanationHtml: 定位 p6：build an enormous storehouse，enormous 与 huge 同义替换。

options.text: A. a huge storehouse（一座巨大的粮仓）
options.html: A. a huge storehouse（一座巨大的粮仓）

options.text: B. a large farm（一座大农场）
options.html: B. a large farm（一座大农场）

options.text: C. a beautiful palace（一座美丽的宫殿）
options.html: C. a beautiful palace（一座美丽的宫殿）

options.text: D. a waterproof kitchen（一间防水厨房）
options.html: D. a waterproof kitchen（一间防水厨房）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:3.explanation: 定位 p6：build an enormous storehouse，enormous 与 huge 同义替换。

teaching.translation: 为防饥荒，国王命人建造了什么？

phrases.meaning: 一座巨大的粮仓（enormous ↔ huge 同义）

optionAnalysis.why: 原文 he ordered his men to build an enormous storehouse；enormous 与 huge 是同义替换，storehouse＝粮仓。
farm（农场）原文未提，装玉米的是 storehouse。
palace（宫殿）无中生有；波斯王子的宫殿被移植进国王的故事。
原文说 storehouse made waterproof and fireproof（粮仓防水防火），被换成 waterproof kitchen（防水厨房），改造了对象。

steps: 审题：圈 prevent famine、build，回国王的故事定位。
定位：build an enormous storehouse, which he filled with corn。
比对：A 是同义替换（enormous ↔ huge）；D 借用原文 waterproof 偷换对象，B、C 未提。

sourceContext.label: 课件 · 练习一《无尽的故事》第 2 段（国王的故事）
sourceContext.quote: So he ordered his men to build an enormous storehouse, which he filled with corn.

zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:4.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:4.stem: The thing the King noticed first in the roof was _____.（国王最先在屋顶发现什么？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:4.stemHtml: The thing the King noticed first in the roof was _____.（国王最先在屋顶发现什么？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:4.explanationHtml: 定位 p7：noticed a small hole in the roof，先看到小洞，随后才看到蝗虫和玉米粒。

options.text: B. a small hole（一个小洞）
options.html: B. a small hole（一个小洞）

options.text: C. a grain of corn（一粒玉米）
options.html: C. a grain of corn（一粒玉米）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p1:4.explanation: 定位 p7：noticed a small hole in the roof，先看到小洞，随后才看到蝗虫和玉米粒。

teaching.translation: 国王最先在屋顶上注意到的是什么？

phrases.text: notice a small hole in the roof
phrases.meaning: 注意到屋顶上一个小洞

optionAnalysis.why: loaf（面包）原文未提；粮食是 corn（玉米）。
原文 he noticed a small hole in the roof：先看（noticed）到的是洞，然后才看到钻出的蝗虫。
玉米粒是蝗虫叼出来的，属于第二眼看到的东西，不是「最先注意到」的。
蝗虫也是从洞里钻出来才被看到的，顺序在「小洞」之后；问 first 就要按时间先后比对。

steps: 审题：抓住 first（最先），这是顺序限定词。
定位：he noticed a small hole in the roof and, as he looked at it, a locust came out…。
比对：注意到洞的动作最先发生，选 B；蝗虫和玉米粒都在之后。

sourceContext.label: 课件 · 练习一《无尽的故事》第 2 段（国王的故事）
sourceContext.quote: But one day he noticed a small hole in the roof and, as he looked at it, a locust came out with a grain of corn.

zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:0.stem: Which of the following is NOT a function of QR codes?（以下哪项不是二维码的功能？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:0.stemHtml: Which of the following is NOT a function of QR codes?（以下哪项不是二维码的功能？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:0.explanationHtml: 定位 p8：二维码被读取器扫描，而不是「扫描读取器」；其余三项都有原文依据。

options.text: B. Scanning a reader（扫描读取器）
options.html: B. Scanning a reader（扫描读取器）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:0.explanation: 定位 p8：二维码被读取器扫描，而不是「扫描读取器」；其余三项都有原文依据。

teaching.translation: 以下哪项不是二维码的功能？

optionAnalysis.why: 存储数据是二维码的基本功能（could hold much more information），A 属实，不是题目所求。
原文 anyone can scan it with any reader 是「任何读取器都能扫二维码」，方向被 B 反转为「二维码扫描读取器」；主宾倒置，不是其功能。
社交（add new friends、create social options）原文有依据，C 属实。
移动支付（make payment）原文首段即有，D 属实。

steps: 审题：圈 NOT，注意要选「不是功能」的项。
逐项定位：存储数据、社交、付款在 (1)(3) 段均有依据。
判定：B 把「被扫描」说成「扫描别人」，主宾关系被倒置。

sourceContext.label: 课件 · 练习二《二维码》第 3 段
sourceContext.quote: Do not limit a QR code to one mobile scanner: anyone can scan it with any reader.

zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:1.stem: Why is the bar code mentioned in Paragraph 2?（第 2 段为什么提到条形码？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:1.stemHtml: Why is the bar code mentioned in Paragraph 2?（第 2 段为什么提到条形码？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:1.explanationHtml: 定位 p9：用一维条形码作对比，突出二维码容量大、尺寸小、耐损坏等特点。

options.text: A. To introduce the main topic（引出主题）
options.html: A. To introduce the main topic（引出主题）

options.text: B. To show the author’s attitude（表明作者态度）
options.html: B. To show the author’s attitude（表明作者态度）

options.text: C. To highlight the features of QR codes（突出二维码的特点）
options.html: C. To highlight the features of QR codes（突出二维码的特点）

options.text: D. To add some background knowledge（补充背景知识）
options.html: D. To add some background knowledge（补充背景知识）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:1.explanation: 定位 p9：用一维条形码作对比，突出二维码容量大、尺寸小、耐损坏等特点。

teaching.translation: 第 2 段为什么提到条形码？

optionAnalysis.why: 二维码本身是段落的主题，条形码只是被拿来作参照的配角，「引出主题」说反了两者的角色。
作者对条形码没有表达个人态度，只是客观对比其局限。把说明手法读成态度属反客为主。
段中用条形码容量小作对照，突出二维码 could hold much more information、larger data capacity、smaller print-out size、higher resistance to damage 等特点——提到条形码是为了反衬二维码的优势。
「补充背景知识」太泛；段落的功能是对比突出特点，不是中性地介绍背景。

steps: 审题：问提到条形码的目的，找第 2 段的说明手法。
定位：工程师感到 one-dimensional bar code 的 limitation，于是开发二维码；随后列出二维码的优势。
比对：写作意图是反衬特点，选 C；A 颠倒主配角，B 加态度，D 过泛。

sourceContext.label: 课件 · 练习二《二维码》第 2 段
sourceContext.quote: QR codes could hold much more information than bar codes due to their extra dimension. In addition, QR codes have larger data capacity, smaller print-out size and higher resistance to damage.

zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:2.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:2.stem: Which best explains “vulnerability” in Paragraph 4?（第 4 段的 vulnerability 最接近哪一义项？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:2.stemHtml: Which best explains “vulnerability” in Paragraph 4?（第 4 段的 vulnerability 最接近哪一义项？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:2.explanationHtml: 定位 p10：后文犯罪分子可替换码盗款，语境说明其「弱点、脆弱性」。
zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:2.explanation: 定位 p10：后文犯罪分子可替换码盗款，语境说明其「弱点、脆弱性」。

teaching.translation: 哪项最能解释第 4 段中的 vulnerability？

phrases.text: transfer cash to one's own bank accounts
phrases.meaning: 把现金转入自己的银行账户

optionAnalysis.why: 二维码是受害方，犯罪分子才是 threat（威胁）；把受害者的属性说成威胁，主客颠倒。
后文紧接解释：criminals can steal simply by replacing the QR codes（替换二维码即可盗款），语境说明二维码有弱点、脆弱性，vulnerability＝weakness。
difficulty（困难）与「容易被利用来盗窃」的语境不符，利用的是其漏洞而非困难。
simplicity（简单）原文未提；二维码技术 complicated，恰是「技术复杂但易被滥用」的反差。

steps: 审题：猜 vulnerability，读本段后续解释。
定位：Due to their easy access, criminals can steal simply by replacing the QR codes…。
比对：「易被替换盗款」= 弱点，选 B；A 主客颠倒，C、D 与语境不合。

sourceContext.label: 课件 · 练习二《二维码》第 4 段
sourceContext.quote: Meanwhile, we must also recognize the vulnerability of QR codes. Due to their easy access, criminals can steal simply by replacing the QR codes with their own, transferring cash to their own bank accounts.

zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:3.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:3.stem: How could we customize our own QR code?（怎样定制自己的二维码？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:3.stemHtml: How could we customize our own QR code?（怎样定制自己的二维码？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:3.explanationHtml: 定位 p11：adjust the color, add a logo, create social options 三项均出现。

options.text: A. By adding a special logo（添加特殊标志）
options.html: A. By adding a special logo（添加特殊标志）

options.text: B. By changing the color（改变颜色）
options.html: B. By changing the color（改变颜色）

options.text: C. By creating various social options（创建多种社交选项）
options.html: C. By creating various social options（创建多种社交选项）

options.text: D. All of the above（以上都是）
options.html: D. All of the above（以上都是）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:3.explanation: 定位 p11：adjust the color, add a logo, create social options 三项均出现。

teaching.translation: 我们如何定制自己的二维码？

phrases.text: adjust the color / add a logo / create social options
phrases.meaning: 调整颜色 / 添加标志 / 创建社交选项

optionAnalysis.why: add a logo 确实是定制方式之一，但只选 A 不全面——题干问「怎样定制」，后文还有两项。
adjust the color 也是原文三项之一，单独选不完整。
create social options 同为三项之一，单独选同样不完整。
原文 adjust the color, add a logo or create social options 三项并列，All of the above 完整覆盖。

steps: 审题：问定制方式，圈 customize。
定位：we customize the design according to our needs: adjust the color, add a logo or create social options。
比对：三项全中，选 D（以上都是）；单选任何一项都漏项。

sourceContext.label: 课件 · 练习二《二维码》第 3 段
sourceContext.quote: The process can be fun when we customize the design according to our needs: adjust the color, add a logo or create social options.

zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:4.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:4.stem: Which is TRUE about QR codes according to the passage?（根据文章，哪项关于二维码的说法正确？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:4.stemHtml: Which is TRUE about QR codes according to the passage?（根据文章，哪项关于二维码的说法正确？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:4.explanationHtml: 定位 p12：anyone can scan … with any reader；A、B、C 均与原文相反。

options.text: A. They were first used in China（它们最先在中国使用）
options.html: A. They were first used in China（它们最先在中国使用）

options.text: B. The generators charge users a lot（生成器收费很高）
options.html: B. The generators charge users a lot（生成器收费很高）

options.text: C. Data editing is possible in printed QR codes（打印后的二维码仍能编辑数据）
options.html: C. Data editing is possible in printed QR codes（打印后的二维码仍能编辑数据）

options.text: D. More scanning devices are available for reading QR codes（有更多设备可读取二维码）
options.html: D. More scanning devices are available for reading QR codes（有更多设备可读取二维码）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p2:4.explanation: 定位 p12：anyone can scan … with any reader；A、B、C 均与原文相反。

teaching.translation: 根据文章，关于二维码的哪项说法正确？

optionAnalysis.why: 原文说二维码 originated in Japan，在中国是 popular（普及），「最先在中国使用」与起源地相反。
原文 many of which are available online for free（很多生成器免费），「收费很高」与原文相反。
原文 standard QR codes cannot be edited once printed（打印后不能改），「仍能编辑」与原文相反。
原文 Do not limit a QR code to one mobile scanner: anyone can scan it with any reader，即可用多种读取设备扫描，D 与原文一致。

steps: 审题：Which is TRUE，四个选项逐项核对。
逐项定位：起源（日本）、生成器（免费）、打印后不可编辑、任何读取器可扫。
判定：只有 D 与原文同向；A、B、C 都与原文相反。

sourceContext.label: 课件 · 练习二《二维码》第 3 段
sourceContext.quote: Do not limit a QR code to one mobile scanner: anyone can scan it with any reader.

zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:0.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:0.stem: A social media influencer is someone who _____.（社交媒体影响者是怎样的人？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:0.stemHtml: A social media influencer is someone who _____.（社交媒体影响者是怎样的人？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:0.explanationHtml: 定位 p13–14：influence the decisions of followers，题干换成购物决定。

options.text: A. pays followers for new products（付钱让粉丝购买新品）
options.html: A. pays followers for new products（付钱让粉丝购买新品）

options.text: B. takes social relationship courses（学习社交关系课程）
options.html: B. takes social relationship courses（学习社交关系课程）

options.text: C. specializes in social media studies（专门研究社交媒体）
options.html: C. specializes in social media studies（专门研究社交媒体）

options.text: D. affects the shopping decisions of followers（影响粉丝的购物决定）
options.html: D. affects the shopping decisions of followers（影响粉丝的购物决定）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:0.explanation: 定位 p13–14：influence the decisions of followers，题干换成购物决定。

teaching.translation: 社交媒体影响者是怎样的人？

optionAnalysis.why: 「付钱让粉丝买新品」原文未提；影响者是说服别人买，不是自己付钱。
「学习社交关系课程」无中生有；原文说的是 knowledge in a particular area（某一领域的知识）。
「专门研究社交媒体」是对 knowledge in a particular area 的曲解，领域不限于社交媒体。
定位 An influencer is a person who can influence the decisions of followers，与题干 decide what to buy 对应，即影响粉丝的购物决定。

steps: 审题：问 influencer 的定义，找 What is an influencer 段。
定位：can influence the decisions of followers because of the relationship with the audience and his or her knowledge。
比对：D 与定义对应；A、B、C 均为外加信息或曲解。

sourceContext.label: 课件 · 练习三《社交媒体影响者》第 2 段
sourceContext.quote: An influencer is a person who can influence the decisions of followers because of the relationship with the audience and his or her knowledge in a particular area.

zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:1.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:1.stem: Many companies want to use influencers to _____.（许多公司使用影响者来做什么？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:1.stemHtml: Many companies want to use influencers to _____.（许多公司使用影响者来做什么？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:1.explanationHtml: 定位 p15：公司让影响者 market their products，即帮助销售产品。

options.text: A. sell their products（销售产品）
options.html: A. sell their products（销售产品）

options.text: B. develop new products（开发新品）
options.html: B. develop new products（开发新品）

options.text: C. design their own websites（设计网站）
options.html: C. design their own websites（设计网站）

options.text: D. examine customers’ hearts（研究顾客心理）
options.html: D. examine customers’ hearts（研究顾客心理）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:1.explanation: 定位 p15：公司让影响者 market their products，即帮助销售产品。

teaching.translation: 许多公司借助影响者来做什么？

phrases.text: have the power to persuade people

phrases.meaning: 推广他们的产品（market ↔ sell 同义）

optionAnalysis.why: 原文 many companies ask powerful influencers to market their products；market（推销）与 sell（销售）是同义替换，目的是卖产品。
「开发新品」原文未提；公司是让影响者推广现有产品。
「设计网站」无中生有；medium 是影响者自己选的平台，不是公司请他们建网站。
「研究顾客心理」原文未提；persuade people to buy things 是说服购买，不是心理研究。

steps: 审题：问公司用影响者的目的，圈 companies。
定位：many companies ask powerful influencers to market their products。
比对：market ↔ sell，选 A；B、C、D 均为原文没有的功能。

sourceContext.label: 课件 · 练习三《社交媒体影响者》第 3 段
sourceContext.quote: They have the power to persuade people to buy things, and many companies ask powerful influencers to market their products.

zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:2.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:2.stem: According to Paragraph 4, why are many people eager to be influencers?（根据第 4 段，为什么许多人渴望成为影响者？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:2.stemHtml: According to Paragraph 4, why are many people eager to be influencers?（根据第 4 段，为什么许多人渴望成为影响者？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:2.explanationHtml: 定位 p16：例举扶贫直播销量，并说活动鼓励更多人成为影响者。

options.text: A. They may run their own companies（可以经营自己的公司）
options.html: A. They may run their own companies（可以经营自己的公司）

options.text: B. They want to buy agricultural products（想购买农产品）
options.html: B. They want to buy agricultural products（想购买农产品）

options.text: C. They want to contribute to poverty reduction（想为扶贫作贡献）
options.html: C. They want to contribute to poverty reduction（想为扶贫作贡献）

options.text: D. They want more chances to access blogs（想获得更多访问博客的机会）
options.html: D. They want more chances to access blogs（想获得更多访问博客的机会）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:2.explanation: 定位 p16：例举扶贫直播销量，并说活动鼓励更多人成为影响者。

teaching.translation: 根据第 4 段，为什么许多人渴望成为影响者？

phrases.text: be targeted at helping poverty reduction
encourage more and more people to become influencers
phrases.meaning: 鼓励越来越多的人成为影响者

optionAnalysis.why: 「经营自己的公司」原文未提；成为影响者不等于开公司。
「想购买农产品」颠倒了方向：直播是帮别人卖农产品，不是影响者自己想买。
第 4 段举扶贫直播带动 45,000 公斤农产品销售的例子，并说 Such events have encouraged more and more people to become influencers——受助人事例的鼓舞，想为扶贫作贡献（呼应首段 eliminating poverty in China）。
「获得更多访问博客的机会」无中生有；medium 是工作平台不是目的。

steps: 审题：问渴望成为影响者的原因，定位第 4 段。
定位：扶贫活动销量 + Such events have encouraged more and more people to become influencers。
比对：例子指向扶贫贡献，选 C；B 方向颠倒，A、D 无依据。

sourceContext.label: 课件 · 练习三《社交媒体影响者》第 4 段
sourceContext.quote: According to a report from China Daily, in an event targeted at helping poverty reduction, influencers attracted more than 930,000 views. More than 45,000 kilograms of agricultural products, at a total value of 40,000 yuan, were ordered within a few hours. Such events have encouraged more and more people to become influencers.

zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:3.title: 阅读理解 Reading Comprehension
zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:3.stem: What is the best way for influencers to connect with followers?（影响者联系粉丝的最佳方式是什么？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:3.stemHtml: What is the best way for influencers to connect with followers?（影响者联系粉丝的最佳方式是什么？）
zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:3.explanationHtml: 定位 p17：The best way … is to decide which medium to use，即选对网络平台。

options.text: A. Focusing on their comments（关注评论）
options.html: A. Focusing on their comments（关注评论）

options.text: B. Chatting with their best friends（与最好的朋友聊天）
options.html: B. Chatting with their best friends（与最好的朋友聊天）

options.text: C. Choosing the right online platform（选择合适的网络平台）
options.html: C. Choosing the right online platform（选择合适的网络平台）

options.text: D. Describing their favorite things（描述其喜好）
options.html: D. Describing their favorite things（描述其喜好）

zsb-english:19:quiz-p3:3.explanation: 定位 p17：The best way … is to decide which medium to use，即选对网络平台。

teaching.translation: 影响者联系粉丝的最佳方式是什么？

optionAnalysis.why: 「关注评论」原文未提；文章只说选平台和写简介两条。
「与最好的朋友聊天」无中生有；best friends 属日常联想。
原文 The best way to connect with followers is to decide which medium to use：最佳方式是选对网络平台（blog、WeChat、TikTok）。
「描述喜好」是第二步 write an interesting bio 的内容，不是题干问的 the best way；注意区分两条建议的主次。

steps: 审题：圈 the best way，回原文找同短语。
定位：The best way to connect with followers is to decide which medium to use, such as your own online blog, WeChat or TikTok。
比对：C 对应 medium（网络平台）；D 是次要的第二条建议。
