zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:6.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:6.stem: 第三段「重申主题与寒暄」的套话是哪句？
zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:6.stemHtml: 第三段「重申主题与寒暄」的套话是哪句？
zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:6.explanationHtml: 笔记补充解析（第三段）：本段为非重点段落，只需重申主题；若有必要，配上一两句寒暄套话即可。

options.text: A. Please accept my sincere gratitude to you for reading the content above. If you need to know more about it, please contact me.
options.html: A. Please accept my sincere gratitude to you for reading the content above. If you need to know more about it, please contact me.

options.text: B. It is generally recognized that nothing is more important.
options.html: B. It is generally recognized that nothing is more important.

options.text: C. I am most reluctant to complain.
options.html: C. I am most reluctant to complain.

options.text: D. May I have the honor to invite you?
options.html: D. May I have the honor to invite you?

zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:6.explanation: 笔记补充解析（第三段）：本段为非重点段落，只需重申主题；若有必要，配上一两句寒暄套话即可。

teaching.translation: 衷心感谢你阅读以上内容。如需了解更多信息，请与我联系。（第三段重申主题后的寒暄套话）

phrases.text: Please accept my sincere gratitude to you for reading the content above.
phrases.meaning: 感谢阅读——第三段寒暄套话第一句

phrases.text: If you need to know more about it, please contact me.
phrases.meaning: 保持联系的寒暄句（第三段套话第二句）

optionAnalysis.why: 第三段「重申主题＋寒暄」的课件套话正是 Please accept my sincere gratitude to you for reading the content above. If you need to know more about it, please contact me.。来源：课件未附答案，本条为笔记补充解析。
It is generally recognized that nothing is more important. 是句型一「最高级价值」，属于第二段理由句。干扰点：都是完整的正式句。
I am most reluctant to complain. 是投诉信开头句式。干扰点：投诉信也可能以「感谢阅读」收尾，但该句本身是开头。
May I have the honor to invite you? 是邀请信开头句式。干扰点：邀请信的寒暄贯穿首尾，但该句是开头邀请句。

steps: 先定位考点：第三段「重申主题＋寒暄」的套话。
再核对课件原文两句：Please accept my sincere gratitude... / If you need to know more...。
最后排除第二段句型 B 与首段体裁句 C、D。

sourceContext.label: 课件·万能展开 8. 第三段与分类型结尾（第三段套话）
sourceContext.quote: 第三段为非重点段落，只需重申主题；若有必要，配上一两句寒暄套话即可：Please accept my sincere gratitude to you for reading the content above. If you need to know more about it, please contact me.

keyPoints: 第三段＝重申主题＋可选寒暄一句
套话原文：Please accept my sincere gratitude to you for reading the content above. If you need to know more about it, please contact me.
通知、演讲稿等体裁换用 We hope... / Thank you for your listening.
subjective.derivation: 正文写完 → 把主旨压缩成一句重申 → 需要联系窗口时加套话；不新增任何要点。

zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:7.title: 作文 Writing
zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:7.stem: 改错：课件原句 “Classmates help me make up for the missed lessons also meant a great deal to me.” 有搭配问题，改成哪句最规范？
zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:7.stemHtml: 改错：课件原句 “Classmates help me make up for the missed lessons also meant a great deal to me.” 有搭配问题，改成哪句最规范？
zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:7.explanationHtml: 原文语言点（笔记补充解析）：课件原句以 Classmates help me... 开头，存在所有格/动名词搭配问题；正式写作可改为 My classmates’ help in making up for the missed lessons also meant a great deal to me.。

options.text: A. Classmates help me make up for the missed lessons also meant a great deal to me.
options.html: A. Classmates help me make up for the missed lessons also meant a great deal to me.

options.text: B. My classmates helped me make up for the missed lessons, that meant a great deal to me.
options.html: B. My classmates helped me make up for the missed lessons, that meant a great deal to me.

options.text: C. My classmates help making up for the missed lessons also meant a great deal to me.
options.html: C. My classmates help making up for the missed lessons also meant a great deal to me.

options.text: D. My classmates’ help in making up for the missed lessons also meant a great deal to me.
options.html: D. My classmates’ help in making up for the missed lessons also meant a great deal to me.

zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:7.explanation: 原文语言点（笔记补充解析）：课件原句以 Classmates help me... 开头，存在所有格/动名词搭配问题；正式写作可改为 My classmates’ help in making up for the missed lessons also meant a great deal to me.。

teaching.translation: 同学们在帮我补上落下的课程方面给予的帮助，对我来说也意义重大。（规范改写句）

phrases.text: make up for the missed lessons
mean a great deal to sb.

phrases.meaning: 某人在做某事上的帮助（名词化结构）

optionAnalysis.why: 原句未改：Classmates help me make up... 里 help 与 meant 两个谓语挤在一句，且 Classmates 与 help 之间缺所有格，搭配不规范。干扰点：原句照搬最省力。
that meant a great deal... 用 that 引导非限制性定语从句，规范英语须用 which；且 helped 与 meant 的时序不如名词化结构稳妥。干扰点：只改了前半句，留下「逗号＋that」的从句方案。
Classmates help making up... 只把 me make 改成 making，句首仍是 Classmates help，help 与 meant 双谓语问题原样保留。干扰点：改动量小，看似「最小修改」。

My classmates' help in making up for the missed lessons also meant a great deal to me. 用所有格 classmates' ＋ 动名词复合结构 help in making... 作主语，全句只剩 meant 一个谓语——这正是课件「原文语言点」栏给出的规范改法。来源：课件未附答案，本条为笔记补充解析（课件原文语言点栏已给出此改法）。

steps: 先数谓语：原句 help 与 meant 两个谓语，必改。
再定改法：把「同学帮忙补课」名词化为 classmates' help in making...。
最后核对干扰项：B 的 that 从句、C 的双谓语残留都不合格，选 D。

sourceContext.label: 课件·练习六「原文语言点」栏
sourceContext.quote: 课件原句以 Classmates help me... 开头，存在所有格/动名词搭配问题。正式写作可改为：My classmates' help in making up for the missed lessons also meant a great deal to me.

keyPoints: 一句只留一个谓语
名词化改法：My classmates' help in making up for the missed lessons ...
所有格（classmates'）＋动名词复合结构（help in doing）
subjective.derivation: 先数谓语（help 与 meant 两个）→ 把其中一半名词化 → 核对所有格与介词 in；这是「一句一谓语」检查的典型应用。
selfEval: 改写后全句只有一个谓语

zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:8.stem: 保持联系／祝好类结尾该用哪句？
zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:8.stemHtml: 保持联系／祝好类结尾该用哪句？
zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:8.explanationHtml: 笔记补充解析（保持联系／祝好）：Should there be anything I can do for you, please contact me without hesitation. / If you need to know more about it, please contact me.。

options.text: A. I am really annoyed at doing ...
options.html: A. I am really annoyed at doing ...

options.text: B. Nothing is more important than time.
options.html: B. Nothing is more important than time.

options.text: C. The following details cannot be neglected.
options.html: C. The following details cannot be neglected.

options.text: D. Should there be anything I can do for you, please contact me without hesitation.
options.html: D. Should there be anything I can do for you, please contact me without hesitation.

zsb-english:24:quiz-p4:8.explanation: 笔记补充解析（保持联系／祝好）：Should there be anything I can do for you, please contact me without hesitation. / If you need to know more about it, please contact me.。

teaching.translation: 如果有任何我能为你做的事，请毫不犹豫地联系我。（保持联系／祝好类结尾句）

phrases.text: Should there be anything I can do for you, please contact me without hesitation.
phrases.meaning: 保持联系句——Should there be 倒装＝If there is

optionAnalysis.why: I am really annoyed at doing ... 是投诉句式（对……恼火）。干扰点：都是表达态度的句子。
Nothing is more important than time. 是句型一的残句（缺 It is generally recognized that 与 for 短语）。干扰点：也含 time，但结构不完整且属第二段。
The following details cannot be neglected. 是第二段段首句四选一之三。干扰点：也有「正式收尾感」，但位置在第二段开头。
保持联系／祝好类结尾句 1 即 Should there be anything I can do for you, please contact me without hesitation.（Should there be 倒装＝If there is），用于第三段末留下联系窗口。来源：课件未附答案，本条为笔记补充解析。

steps: 先定位考点：保持联系／祝好类结尾句。
再核对课件原文：Should there be anything I can do for you, please contact me without hesitation.。
最后排除投诉句式 A、残句句型 B 与段首句 C。

sourceContext.label: 课件·万能展开 8. 第三段与分类型结尾（保持联系／祝好）
sourceContext.quote: 保持联系／祝好：1. Should there be anything I can do for you, please contact me without hesitation. 2. If you need to know more about it, please contact me.

keyPoints: 保持联系句：Should there be anything I can do for you, please contact me without hesitation.
Should there be 倒装＝If there is，可替换
适用场景：帮助类、邀请类结尾留联系窗口
subjective.derivation: 结尾需要留联系窗口 → 选保持联系句 → 放在第三段末；倒装式更正式，平叙式 If there is 也可。
